description: Verify and maintain local development-session recovery for The Node.

hooks.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; node (Join-Path $root 'scripts/session-recovery.mjs') hook-start"
powershell -NoProfile -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; node (Join-Path $root 'scripts/session-recovery.mjs') hook-capture"
